def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    # Find the full dividing row and column.
    hr = next(r for r in range(n) if all(x == 1 for x in grid[r]))
    vc = next(c for c in range(n) if all(grid[r][c] == 1 for r in range(n)))

    quadrants = [
        (0, hr, 0, vc, False, False),
        (0, hr, vc + 1, n, True, False),
        (hr + 1, n, 0, vc, False, True),
        (hr + 1, n, vc + 1, n, True, True),
    ]

    def red_box(bounds):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = bounds
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
                 if grid[r][c] == 2]
        if not cells:
            return None
        rs = [p[0] for p in cells]
        cs = [p[1] for p in cells]
        return min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)

    boxes = [red_box(q[:4]) for q in quadrants]
    br0, br1, bc0, bc1 = boxes[0]
    bh, bw = br1 - br0 + 1, bc1 - bc0 + 1

    # Extract the colored rectangular pieces of the upper-left pattern.
    seen = set()
    pieces = []
    for r in range(hr):
        for c in range(vc):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color in (1, 2, 4) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                a, b = stack.pop()
                comp.append((a, b))
                for da, db in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    na, nb = a + da, b + db
                    if (0 <= na < hr and 0 <= nb < vc and
                            (na, nb) not in seen and grid[na][nb] == color):
                        seen.add((na, nb))
                        stack.append((na, nb))
            rs = [p[0] for p in comp]
            cs = [p[1] for p in comp]
            pieces.append((color, min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)))

    for qi in range(1, 4):
        if boxes[qi] is None:
            continue
        tr0, tr1, tc0, tc1 = boxes[qi]
        th, tw = tr1 - tr0 + 1, tc1 - tc0 + 1
        hflip, vflip = quadrants[qi][4], quadrants[qi][5]
        for color, r0, r1, c0, c1 in pieces:

                for cc in range(out_c0, out_c0 + out_w):
                    if 0 <= rr < n and 0 <= cc < n:
                        g[rr][cc] = color
    return g
